capabilities: Fetch today's TickTick tasks into a sidebar panel via macOS JXA
Mark tasks complete with real-time sync back to TickTick
Show project names, pinned priority, and human-readable due times
Jump to TickTick via deep links for detailed task editing
Auto-refresh task status on a configurable interval
disambiguation: Not a task manager for Obsidian; it only displays and completes tasks that live in the TickTick app.
extras: macOS only (uses JXA and requires granting Obsidian Accessibility permissions); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author built it as an auxiliary GTD tool so users can view and complete daily tasks while writing and thinking in Obsidian, with task management kept in TickTick.
problem: GTD practitioners working in Obsidian must switch to the TickTick app to see and complete today's tasks.

relations.evidence: Fetches TickTick today's tasks via macOS JXA API

requires.name: TickTick (macOS app, installed and logged in)

summary: Sidebar panel that fetches today's tasks from the TickTick macOS app and lets you mark them complete without leaving Obsidian.
